# Better Than Default
> An iPhone app that helps you improve ten phone defaults, one at a time: settings and simple habits, each with an evidence label (Backed by research, Small study, Our advice, not proven). No account, no tracking, no server. Free to start, one-time purchase for the full version, no subscription. Not in the App Store yet; no release date.

- [Home (Nederlands)](https://betterthandefault.app/nl/)
